Quantifiers remain `forall p in A intersect P exists declared e`, which is not automatically a single `exists e forall p`. Nonclosure alone remains insufficient. The 14 published files were then read back from this exact commit and verified byte-for-byte. The old `LOCAL_VALIDATION_PENDING` and FQ007 shared-surface propagation debt are resolved. The existing RS-GOV-FOUNDATION-BACKFLOW continuation is being advanced through its typed runtime path; this comment creates no CLAIM, Result, review, or task DONE event. Global-knowledge propagation and the exact runtime handoff are recorded separately.
